notRead: current v5/v6 app source or prompts
isolation.note: Prior Q606 replay-tool engineering context exists; this preparation did not open any earlier held-out artifacts or current application implementation. All ten texts, dates, tickers and ids were authored anew for this dispatch.

dataset.fictional: All source titles and facts are synthetic; ticker names are identifiers, not assertions about actual companies.

execution.versions: Follow-up only after source-ready; record exact supplied implementation identities and confirmed response versions.
execution.pairs: Identical request/evidence/asOf/caseId across versions, one fresh isolated invocation per case per version; fresh trace and conversation UUIDs.
execution.blindReview: Judge both response sets independently against this frozen rubric before opening version labels or comparing scores. Preserve verbatim responses privately. Record reason and supporting answer span for every failure/critical.
execution.noTuning: Do not expose raw cases/rubrics to implementation coders before the final source version is frozen. No edits, replacement cases or selective reruns after responses are seen. A necessary correction requires a new protocol and explicit invalidation of this run.
execution.failurePolicy: Provider/transport/configuration failures are operational failures, not successes. Any missing pair leaves gate PENDING rather than dropping denominator. Retry only in an explicitly recorded new full evaluation run; retain original records.

gate.normalRegression: A normal case that passes for baseline and fails for candidate. Both are judged under the same rubric; baseline failures do not excuse candidate failures.
gate.decision: PASS only when all complete-pair, candidate pass count, critical count and normal regression conditions hold; otherwise FAIL, except incomplete or disputed grading is PENDING.
gate.disagreement: Record disputed criteria and seek independent adjudication without rewriting rubric; do not silently award a pass.

reporting.coordinator: Only artifact directory, file/manifest SHA-256, count and frozen timestamp until authorized independent evaluation follow-up.
reporting.implementationCoder: No raw cases, rubrics, protocol content or outputs before version freeze.
